name: EPIC 206005708
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.1 solar radii and 1.10 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206005708 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.073685 (16th-84th percentiles 8.705077-9.465979), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206005708 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.101566 (16th-84th percentiles 0.9981-1.217999), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206005708: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4846.3613 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206005708 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3528.945312 (16th-84th percentiles 3418.515625-3644.609375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.12 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,529 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.10 solar masses and 9.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,846 K at its surface.
